extensionDescription.message: Findet und dekodiert Data-Matrix-, QR- und andere 2D-Codes in der angezeigten E-Mail. Arbeitet lokal und offline.

codesCountOne.description: Overlay header when exactly one code was found.

codesCountOther.description: Overlay header with the number of codes found. $1 = count.

scanning.description: Accessible label of the spinner shown while a scan is running.

minimize.description: Tooltip of the button that collapses the overlay to a badge.

restore.description: Tooltip of the badge that restores the overlay.

overlayLabel.description: Accessible name of the overlay panel.

copy.description: Button that copies a decoded code.

copied.description: Shown on the copy button for a moment after copying.

copyFailed.description: Shown on the copy button when copying failed.

inlineImage.description: Source label for an image embedded in the message body.

sourceWithPage.description: Source label for a PDF page. $1 = file name, $2 = page number.

copyAsHri.description: Button that copies a GS1 code in bracketed human-readable form, e.g. (01)…(17)….

binaryTag.description: Tag on a code whose payload is binary data, shown as Base64.

sourceMore.description: Source label of a code found in several places. $1 = first source, $2 = number of further sources.

errorTooLarge.description: Scan error. $1 = source label, $2 = size in MB, $3 = limit in MB.

errorTimeout.description: Scan error. $1 = source label, $2 = timeout in seconds.

errorPageLimit.message: $1 – nur die ersten $2 von $3 Seiten gescannt
errorPageLimit.description: Scan note. $1 = file name, $2 = pages scanned, $3 = total pages.

scanActionTitle.description: Toolbar button in the message window that starts a scan when automatic scanning is off.

optionsAutoScanHint.message: Wenn ausgeschaltet, die Schaltfläche „Nach Codes suchen“ in der Nachrichten-Symbolleiste verwenden.
optionsAutoScanHint.description: Hint below the automatic scanning checkbox.

optionsSources.description: Settings section heading for scan sources.

sourceImageAttachments.description: Settings checkbox for scanning image attachments.

sourceInlineImages.description: Settings checkbox for scanning inline images.

sourcePdfs.description: Settings checkbox for scanning PDF attachments.

optionsFormats.description: Settings section heading for code formats.

formatsAtLeastOne.message: Mindestens ein Format muss aktiviert bleiben.
formatsAtLeastOne.description: Shown when the user tries to disable the last code format.

optionsLimits.description: Settings section heading for size and time limits.

limitMaxImageMegapixels.message: Größte Bildgröße (Megapixel); größere Bilder werden verkleinert

limitOutOfRange.message: Bitte eine ganze Zahl von $1 bis $2 eingeben.

optionsSaved.description: Shown briefly after a setting was saved.

optionsSaveFailed.message: Die Einstellungen konnten nicht gespeichert werden.
optionsSaveFailed.description: Shown when saving the settings failed.

optionsReset.description: Button that restores the default settings.
